reviews.depicted_subject: A generic cross-modal/RAG pipeline segment showing chunked text, a text encoder, retriever/database, an LLM block, and a reliability screen.
reviews.rationale: The final crop does not visibly identify Deepseek-V3 or isolate its exact input interface. It depicts a broader scientifically related pipeline with a generic LLM and downstream reliability screening, so the crop is not specific enough to verify an actual input route for the named target model.

reviews.depicted_subject: Projected DNA embeddings from a frozen Evo2 encoder stacked with text embeddings and fed through the Qwen3 tokenizer/embedding interface into Qwen3-4B.
reviews.rationale: The crop visibly shows the DNA-sequence route into the named hybrid model: DNA sequences go through frozen Evo2-1B, a learnable linear projection, and are stacked with text embeddings at the Qwen3 interface. This matches the Enformer/Evo2-style dense embedding input route into the Qwen3-4B backbone.

reviews.depicted_subject: A GEMGen generation prompt that asks for compounds conditioned on cell type and gene lists, followed by generated SMILES outputs and downstream filtering/matching modules.
reviews.rationale: The crop visibly includes an instruction box feeding directly into GEMGen generation, with the prompt conditioned on cell type and gene-list information. That is sufficient to verify at least one actual GEMGen input route, even though the crop also includes downstream filtering and scoring stages.
